cvReasons.C-sys: Robotics, defence or security: they look for a systems profile.
cvReasons.C-bank: Banks work a lot in Java and systems: the low-level project is a good signal.
cvReasons.C-role: Systems, infra or low-level role: the low-level project weighs more than a web app.
cvReasons.M-role: Product, full-stack or AI role: the production project fits directly.
cvReasons.C-infra: Infrastructure or tooling company: the low-level project fits their stack.
cvReasons.C-quant: Quant firms value CS fundamentals: a low-level project (a compiler, systems) stands out.
cvReasons.C-bigtech: Big tech screens on CS fundamentals: the low-level project stands out more than another web project.
cvReasons.M-product: Product company: the production project shows you ship a complete product.
